description: Data for "Hot-carrier transfer across a nanoparticle-molecule junction: The importance of orbital hybridization and level alignment" is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Chalmers University of Technology. This upload includes the data presented and analyzed in the article "Hot-carrier transfer across a nanoparticle-molecule junction: The importance of orbital hybridization and level alignment" by Jakub Fojt, Tuomas P. Rossi, Mikael Kuisma, and Paul Erhart. The codes for reproducing the data are provided at doi:10.5281/zenodo.7118376. See README.md in data.zip for a detailed description. Coverage: Chalmers University of Technology. The publisher named on the listing is Chalmers University of Technology. Its keywords include Chalmers University of Technology. The listing shows 2022-10-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
